CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

3. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

4. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Football.

   D. Damage equipment used for Football.

6. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.

   C. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.

8. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

10. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.

11. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)

   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

13. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

14. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

15. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
